settings.subtitle: Live departures, door-to-door commutes and road traffic for all of Sweden.

keys.title: 1. API keys (free)
keys.intro: Trafikkollen gets its data straight from the official open APIs. Each Homey uses its own free keys, which takes about five minutes to set up.
keys.tlSteps:
• Create a free account at trafiklab.se and log in.
  • Open My projects → Create new project (any name).
  • In the project, add the API Trafiklab Realtime APIs with the Bronze level (free).
  • Copy the key that appears and paste it here.
keys.tvSteps:
• Go to data.trafikverket.se and register (free).
  • Log in, open My account → API keys and create a new key.
  • Copy the key and paste it here.
keys.how: How do I get a key?

commutes.title: 2. Commutes
commutes.intro: A commute shows door-to-door public transport options (with changes), the car route and the weather in the Commute dashboard widget.
commutes.addFirst: Add your API keys first: the commute setup searches stops with the Trafiklab key.
commutes.name: Name
commutes.viaHint: One or more stops where you change, e.g. a central station. If trains and trams/buses use different stops there (as at Göteborg C: Centralstation and Nils Ericsonsplatsen), add them all. Leave empty for direct trips only. All lines are considered automatically.
commutes.toHint: Add every stop within walking distance of the destination; the fastest one wins. Set the walk from each stop.
commutes.walkTo: Walk from home to the first stop
commutes.hoursHint: e.g. 06:30-09:00. The widget updates more often in these hours and the weather shows them.
commutes.roadsHint: Comma-separated road numbers on your route, e.g. 108, E22. Empty = all roads in the area.
commutes.find: Find cameras and speed sensors along the route
commutes.noSensors: No speed sensors near the route.
commutes.needEnds: Pick the From and To stops first.
commutes.weather: Show the weather at the start and destination (SMHI)
commutes.testOk: Works: {{n}} connection(s) found in the next two hours.
commutes.testNone: No connections found in the next two hours. Check the stops, or try again during service hours.
commutes.errTo: Add at least one To stop.
commutes.advanced: Advanced: edit all commutes as JSON
commutes.addrPh: Address or place, e.g. Drottninggatan 1, Stockholm
commutes.addrNone: No place found. Try adding the town, or the name of the workplace.
commutes.nearStops: Stops within walking distance of {{place}} (tick the ones you could use):
commutes.suggesting: Trying the busiest stops between start and destination against live departures…
commutes.viaNone: No connections found right now. Try again during the day, or add a change stop yourself.
commutes.viaHintDone: Example journeys right now; the widget always shows the live ones.
commutes.routeRes: Showing cameras and speed sensors near a straight line {{from}} to the destination. Fill in your normal driving time and the road numbers yourself.
commutes.arriveByHint: For example 08:00. Then the widget and the "Time to leave" and engine heater Flow cards plan for the latest trip that still gets you there in time. Leave empty to just see the next trips.
commutes.remind: Remind me before I need to leave
commutes.remindUnit: min before (Flow card "Time to leave for a commute")
commutes.returnHint: Make the same trip in the other direction
commutes.returnCheck: This is the trip home, made from the commute. Check the times and press Save.
commutes.guideTitle: Saved! Put it on a dashboard:
commutes.guideSteps:
• In the Homey app, open Dashboards (at the bottom).
  • Make a new dashboard with +, or open one and tap Edit.
  • Tap + Add widget → Trafikkollen → Commute.
  • In the widget settings, pick {{name}}.
commutes.alertsHint: In the commute hours: cancelled or late trips, messages about your lines, accidents and other road messages on the car route (not roadworks), slippery roads and queues. Each problem is sent once a day as a Homey notification (it reaches your phone if notifications are on for this app in the Homey app). You can also use the Flow card "There is a problem on a commute".
